description: arXiv:2607.26472v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Audio deepfake detectors often degrade when generators, corpora, or recording conditions change. We use a Diffusion Transformer (DiT), trained only on bona fide speech, as a frozen reconstruction probe.
